notes: A client needs two landscape photographs of 1400+ beside those its steps point at; with fewer the opening or the card grid falls back to a plain dark band.

Prices in an ungrouped catalogue sit in the card body, which shows on hover or focus at desktop width and always on touch screens and phones; grouped catalogues show prices in the card lists and again in the rows.
No alt is shown as text. Control names (menu, close, previous, next) are aria-labels from a small word list by language.

The foot's large name is deliberately tone on tone (as the reference's); it is aria-hidden and set with an ink alpha of .26, which tools/legible.mjs does not judge (it skips inks under .3). The name is readable in the bar.
drops (as written): team.groups[].t (people are shown in one run)
drops (as written): features.items when a catalogue exists (local1: the same ten names; clinic1: the same fifteen)
drops (as written): features.title, catalogue.text beyond 150 characters (the short one is the dark part's large statement)
drops (as written): photographs beyond the slots (local1: 7 of 20, among them the directors' group picture; clinic1: 3 of 22)
drops (as written): project pictures that are small or already shown elsewhere
drops (as written): on phones: the opening's two buttons and the bar's phone / call pills (as the reference; they are in the menu and in the next section)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (media.made is never read)
